question: According to the Census of India (2011), which group of states have a very high percentage of the rural population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar and Sikkim.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Census of India 2011:- The following group of states have a very high percentage of the rural population.
 
 
• Himachal Pradesh: 90.83%
 
• Odisha: 84.76%
 
• **Bihar: 80.19%**
 
• **Sikkim: 79.06%**
 
• Meghalaya: 77.32%
 
• Assam: 76.40%
 
• Uttar Pradesh: 74.07%
 
 
 
• These states have a large rural population due to a number of factors, including:-
 
 
• **Geographical location: **Many of these states are located in mountainous or hilly regions, which makes it difficult for urban centers to develop.
 
• **Economic factors:** Many of these states are relatively poor, and there is not as much demand for urban goods and services.
 
• **Cultural factors:** In some of these states, there is a strong cultural preference for rural living.
